//go:build upgradeseed

package store_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Muxcore-Media/userdata-local/internal/models"
	"github.com/Muxcore-Media/userdata-local/internal/store"
)

func TestUpgradeSeed(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_SEED_DB")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("UPGRADE_SEED_DB not set")
	}
	st, err := store.New(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	yr := 1999
	w := true
	nw := false
	for _, u := range []string{"alice@example.com", "bob"} {
		if _, _, err := st.Put(u, models.Blob{
			Progress: map[string]models.ProgressEntry{
				"movie-1": {ID: "movie-1", Kind: models.MediaKindMovie, Title: "Heat", Href: "/movies/movie-1", PositionSec: 120, DurationSec: 3600, UpdatedAt: "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z", Watched: &nw},
				"ep-9":    {ID: "ep-9", Kind: models.MediaKindEpisode, Title: "Pilot", Href: "/tv/ep-9", PositionSec: 3500, DurationSec: 3600, UpdatedAt: "2026-01-03T03:04:05Z", Watched: &w},
			},
			Favorites: map[string]models.FavoriteEntry{
				"movie-2": {ID: "movie-2", Kind: models.MediaKindMovie, Title: "Matrix", Href: "/movies/movie-2", Year: &yr},
			},
			Playlists: []models.Playlist{{ID: "pl-1", Name: "Weekend", ItemIDs: []string{"movie-1", "movie-2"}}},
			Queue:     []models.QueueItem{{ID: "movie-2", Kind: models.MediaKindMovie, Title: "Matrix", Href: "/movies/movie-2"}},
		}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	// second put on alice bumps revision to 2 and sets parental prefs (PIN hash: personal data)
	prefs := models.DefaultPreferences()
	prefs.Display.Theme = "light"
	prefs.Subtitles.Language = "fra"
	prefs.Parental = []byte(`{"kids_mode":true,"max_parental_rating":"PG","pin_hash":"abc123"}`)
	if _, _, err := st.Put("alice@example.com", models.Blob{Prefs: &prefs}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := st.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
